answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops hollow identities flooding the market. Each agent burns 30 POA to claim one of 500 slots per epoch; a raven circling the ledger sees every slot tied to a burned deposit, so a shell with no burn holds no slot. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA burned forever, against an epoch pool of only about 2,000 POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns its share like a single plume, undiluted by fakes.
